Title: Q: LSJ. Psyche! vs Fast Reaction

Messages.Author: SteveHarris
Messages.Body:
Meth 1 controls Vamp A. Meth 2 controls Vamp B and Vamp C.

Vamp B blocks Vamp A's action. Vamp B plays S:CE of some kind. Vamp
A then plays Psyche! to restart combat. I believe that Vamp C does
not get an opportunity to play Fast Reaction at this point.

Let's say the second combat proceeds the same and Vamp B ends combat
with a strike. There is no further Psyche from Vamp B.

Can Vamp C now play Fast Reaction?

Psyche!
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Celerity
[cel] Press.
[CEL] Only usable at the end of combat when both combatants are still
ready. Begin another combat with the opposing minion.

Fast Reaction
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Auspex
Only usable after a combat between a blocking minion you control other
than this vampire and the acting minion.
[aus] Tap this vampire. This vampire enters combat with the acting
minion. The first round of this new combat, the acting minion cannot
strike.
[AUS] As above, with an optional press.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On 12/18/09 10:04 , SteveHarris wrote:
> Meth 1 controls Vamp A. Meth 2 controls Vamp B and Vamp C.
>
> Vamp B blocks Vamp A's action. Vamp B plays S:CE of some kind. Vamp
> A then plays Psyche! to restart combat. I believe that Vamp C does
> not get an opportunity to play Fast Reaction at this point.

Correct.

> Let's say the second combat proceeds the same and Vamp B ends combat
> with a strike. There is no further Psyche from Vamp B.
>
> Can Vamp C now play Fast Reaction?

Yes. A is still the acting minion, B is still the blocking minion, and they have
just completed combat.
